panels.title: db deadlocks + errors (range)
panels.description: Deadlocks, errors and failures of SQL operations over the selected time range.

panels.title: process restarts (range)
panels.description: Number of oc3 process (re)starts over the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, url) (rate(oc3_feeder_request_duration_seconds_bucket{url=~"$oc3_api_url_path", url!="/metrics", code=~"$oc3_api_status_code", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))))
topk(15, sum by (method, url, code) (increase(oc3_feeder_requests_total{url=~"$oc3_api_url_path", code=~"[45]..", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) > 0

panels.title: feed queue length
panels.description: Jobs waiting in the redis queues. A queue that keeps growing means the workers can't keep up.

panels.title: feed job duration p95 by step

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job_type, job_step) (rate(oc3_feed_job_step_duration_seconds_bucket{job_type=~"$oc3_feed_job", job_step=~"$oc3_feed_step", status=~"$oc3_feed_status", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (job_type) (rate(oc3_feed_job_duration_seconds_sum{job_type=~"$oc3_feed_job", status=~"$oc3_feed_status", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (job_type) (rate(oc3_feed_job_duration_seconds_count{job_type=~"$oc3_feed_job", status=~"$oc3_feed_status", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: worker busy time (job seconds per second)
panels.description: Seconds spent running jobs per second. Approaches the number of workers when they are saturated.

panels.title: costliest job steps (total seconds over range)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (job_type, job_step) (increase(oc3_feed_job_step_duration_seconds_sum{job_type=~"$oc3_feed_job", job_step=~"$oc3_feed_step", status=~"$oc3_feed_status", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: sql deadlocks / retries / errors per second
db connection wait
panels.description: Time spent waiting for a free connection. Non-zero means the pool (max open connections) is saturated.

panels.title: status log operations/s
panels.description: Status log change and extend operations.

panels.title: task duration p95 (range)
panels.description: Needs the scheduler with the minute-to-hour buckets; older processes report +Inf for tasks over 10s.

panels.title: runner db errors / requests per second
connected clients
panels.description: Connections minus disconnections since process start.

panels.title: goroutines
panels.description: A steady increase usually means a goroutine leak.
